svg.title: News station data flow from evidence to audio
svg.desc: A slot becomes public evidence, verified briefs, bilingual scripts, measured audio, published catalogues and browser playback. Research gaps trigger a Hosted WebIQ expansion loop. Execution, citation and duration gates protect publication. Beijing midnight expires the previous day's content.
svg.text: Don't just ask for a news script. Move data through a newsroom.
Blue nodes are saved, inspectable data. Purple dashed arrows are the research loop.
D01 · Slot and task input
slot + invocation_id → Hosted idempotent task / checkpoint recovery
D02 · Public-report evidence package
evidence.json · evidence ID / agency / URL / source date / usable facts
D03 · Topics → verified factual briefs
topics.json → briefs.json · topic order, citations, facts and research gaps
Missing useful detail?
expand_news → WebIQ
Hosted search, outside the sandbox
expanded-evidence.json returns to D02
Gaps
D04 · Chinese and English scripts, same facts
cn/script.json → en/script.json · speaker / text / topic_id / citations
Publication gates
Actual task / shell execution records
Citations, agency balance, schemas
Bulletin / section ≤1,200 seconds
Both languages complete first
D05 · Anchor tracks → audio and measured timeline
MAI WAV → Wei 1.25x → FFprobe / FFmpeg → AAC / MP4
D06 · Bilingual public output and today's catalogues
media/cn|en/YYYYMMDD/HHMM.mp4 + scheduled / manual catalogues
Beijing midnight · 00:00
Today's date, not a rolling 24 hours
Prune catalogues + expired files
Old jobs cannot recreate old content
No new-day audio yet → wait, not yesterday
D07 · Web player, headline ticker and source links
45-second refresh · seek to measured story starts · show times in the listener's zone
Microsoft Copilot Harness runs editorial execution. Hosted retains deterministic gates, audio production, storage and daily retention.
